listing.name: Far Cry Instincts — fci-recomp (VinceIP)
listing.summary: Upstream describes story and map-editor support in v0.2.1. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Rare single-player crashes and Windows DPI blur remain; Xbox Live and System Link are unavailable. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own original Xbox Far Cry Instincts ISO or extracted disc files, title ID 55530008, version 1.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the source release package and drag your own disc onto BuildGame.cmd as upstream directs. It compiles the game locally from C; it does not download a complete game. Windows x64 with Direct3D 12 is required.

warnings: Upstream describes story and map-editor support in v0.2.1. A complete playthrough is unconfirmed. Rare single-player crashes and Windows DPI blur remain; Xbox Live and System Link are unavailable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
